SARAISHUU: "SARA, RAISHUU" — Sara comes THE WEEK AFTER NEXT (raishuu = next week).
SARAIGETSU: sa + raigetsu (next month) = THE MONTH AFTER NEXT.
SARAINEN: sa + rainen (next year) = THE YEAR AFTER NEXT.
HAJIME NI: "HA, JIM, MAY" — FIRST, Jim may speak.
KINCHOU-shimasu: "KIN CHOW" — eating with your in-laws, you're NERVOUS.
SHOUKIN: "SHOW KING" — the king of the show wins the PRIZE MONEY.
KIRIN: "KEY RING" — a tall GIRAFFE wears a key ring on its neck.
KORO: "CORO" — those TIMES, DAYS when I was a child (kodomo no koro).
KANAI-masu: "CAN, NIGH" — your DREAM COMES TRUE, it can happen.
OUEN-shimasu: "OH, WHEN?" — fans shout and SUPPORT the team.
KOKORO KARA: kokoro (heart) + kara (from) = FROM THE HEART.
KANSHA-shimasu: "CAN SHAH" — the Shah is GRATEFUL; he THANKS you.
OREI: "OH, RAY of light!" — a gift of GRATITUDE, THANKS.

hiragana/katakana: おげんきでいらっしゃいますか
kanji: お元気でいらっしゃいますか
mnemonic: OGENKI DE IRASSHAIMASU KA: "genki" made very polite — HOW ARE YOU DOING?
MEIWAKU WO KAKEMASU: "MAY WACKY" — the wacky guy CAUSES TROUBLE for everyone.
IKASHI-masu: "EEK, CASH!" — MAKE GOOD USE OF your cash.
